headline: Abolition of some institutions and restructuring of loss-making state companies to follow, says Adrian Câciu
summary: Romanian lawmaker Adrian Câciu said some institutions will be abolished and loss-making state companies restructured. He is vice-chairman of the Chamber of Deputies' budget, finance and banking committee.
why: State-owned companies and public spending decisions affect Romania's budget deficit and the fiscal outlook that investors track in the country.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Urmează desființarea unor instituții și restructurarea unor companii de stat pe pierdere, spune Adrian Câciu
